# Liens

Données de Clément Fabre. On suppose que le débit est en L/s.

# Data

## Load data

Données fournies par Anne Probst. 

```{r bv}
bv <- 361.126
unit_flux = "ton"
```


```{r load-data}
debit <- read_xlsx("leze.xlsx", sheet = "debit")
doc <- read_xlsx("leze.xlsx", sheet = "chimie")

```


```{r merge}
# data table ----
debit_dt <- setDT(debit)
doc_dt <- setDT(doc)

debit_dt[,dhdebit := DateHeure]
doc_dt[,dhdoc := DateHeure]

doc_dt[, doc_id := .I]

leze_dt <- doc_dt[debit_dt, on = "DateHeure", roll = "nearest"
                    ][, diff := abs(as.numeric(dhdebit - dhdoc, units = "secs"))]

# Colonnes à "vider" pour les lignes non retenues
cols_doc <- setdiff(names(doc_dt), "DateHeure")

# Repérer, par groupe doc_id, la ligne à garder (diff minimal)
leze_dt[, keep_row := .I == .I[which.min(diff)], by = doc_id]

# Mettre à NA les colonnes de doc_dt pour les lignes non gardées
leze_dt[keep_row == FALSE, (cols_doc) := NA]
leze_dt[, keep_row := NULL]

leze <- leze_dt[, .(DateHeure, doc_mg.L, q_L.s,poc_mg.L,mes_mg.L,poc_percent)][order(DateHeure)]
leze[, `:=`(
  year = year(DateHeure),
  commondate = update(DateHeure, year = 2000),
  period = as.numeric(difftime(shift(DateHeure, type = "lead"), DateHeure, units = "secs"))
)];
```

Maximum écart de matchs en secondes: 1800 (30 min )

### Characteristics

```{r doc-summary-data}
summary_leze <- merge(
leze %>% subset(!is.na(doc_mg.L)) %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise("Number of DOC observations" = n(), "DOC range, mg/L" = paste(round(quantile(doc_mg.L, probs = c(0,0.5,1), na.rm = T),1), collapse = " / ")),
leze %>% subset(!is.na(q_L.s)) %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise("Number of Q observations" = n(), "Q range, L/s" = paste(round(quantile(q_L.s, probs = c(0,0.5,1), na.rm = T),1), collapse = " / ")), by = "year", all = T) %>% 
  merge(leze %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise("Number of days sampled" = length(unique(as.Date(DateHeure)))), by = "year", all = T) %>%
  merge(leze %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise("Correlation DOC/Q" = round(cor(doc_mg.L, q_L.s, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),2)), by = "year", all = T) %>%
  merge(leze %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise("Median sampling interval, min" = round(median(period, na.rm = T)/60,1)), by = "year", all = T) %>%
  rbind(c("All years", 
          dim(subset(leze, !is.na(doc_mg.L)))[1], 
          paste(quantile(leze$doc_mg.L, probs = c(0,0.5,1), na.rm = T), collapse = " / "), 
          dim(subset(leze, !is.na(q_L.s)))[1], 
          paste(round(quantile(leze$q_L.s, probs = c(0,0.5,1), na.rm = T),1), collapse = " / "), 
          length(unique(as.Date(leze$DateHeure))),
          round(cor(leze$doc_mg.L, leze$q_L.s, use = "pairwise.complete.obs" ),2),
          round(median(leze$period, na.rm = T)/60,1)
           ))  %>%
      rbind(c("Complete years", 
            dim(subset(leze_complete, !is.na(doc_mg.L)))[1], 
            paste(quantile(leze_complete$doc_mg.L, probs = c(0,0.5,1), na.rm = T), collapse = " / "), 
            dim(subset(leze_complete, !is.na(q_L.s)))[1], 
            paste(round(quantile(leze_complete$q_L.s, probs = c(0,0.5,1), na.rm = T),1), collapse = " / "), 
            length(unique(as.Date(leze_complete$DateHeure))),
            round(cor(leze_complete$doc_mg.L, leze_complete$q_L.s, use = "pairwise.complete.obs" ),2),
            round(median(leze_complete$period, na.rm = T)/60,1)
            )
            ) %>%  mutate(`DOCobs/Qobs` = round(as.numeric(`Number of DOC observations`)/as.numeric(`Number of Q observations`),3)) 

knitr::kable(summary_leze, caption = "Summary table of leze data") %>% kableExtra::kable_styling()

```

Moins de 0.10% de données DOC par rapport aux données Q.
Sur auradé, 10% DOC/Q -> incertitude 25%. d'où vient le 25%???

```{r doc-uncertainties}
nyears <- length(complete_years)

q_u <- 0.1
```

### total flux

```{r doc-flux-for-obs}
leze_doc <- leze_complete %>% filter(!is.na(doc_mg.L))

nrep <- 1000
nobs <- dim(leze_doc)[1]

doc_meas <- matrix(leze_doc$doc_mg.L, nrow = nrep, ncol = nobs, byrow = T)
doc_cv <- 3.3*doc_meas^(-0.6) # from all data available on 29/05/2026
doc_random <- matrix(rnorm(nrep*nobs, mean = 0, sd = 1), nrow=nrep, ncol = nobs)
doc_noise <- doc_cv*doc_random
doc_mat <- doc_meas * (1 + doc_noise/100) # final value of doc, with noise in percent

# Q matrix
q_meas <- matrix(leze_doc$q_L.s, nrow = nrep, ncol = nobs, byrow = T) # repeats nrow_boot times the vector q_L.s
q_noise <- matrix(rnorm(nrep*nobs, mean = 0, sd = q_u), nrow = nrep, ncol = nobs) # creates a noise in percent (proportion), between 0 and 10%
q_mat <- q_meas * (1 + q_noise) # final value of q, with noise

# period 
period_mat <- matrix(leze_doc$period, nrow = nrep, ncol = nobs, byrow = T) # in seconds

# Flux per time step
load_ton.s_mat <- doc_mat*1e-9*q_mat*600 # period fixed to 600 s -> otherwise outliers

# Annual flux
index_years <- lapply(complete_years, function(y){which(leze_doc$year == y)}) # list of indices corresponding to each year
sum_loadobs <- sapply(index_years, function(idx){apply(load_ton.s_mat[,idx], 1, sum, na.rm = T)}) # 1 col per year

sum_qobs <- sapply(index_years, function(idx){apply(q_mat[,idx], 1, sum, na.rm = T)})

```

```{r sum-q-tot, cache.lazy = F}

nrep <- 1000
nobs <- dim(leze_complete)[1]

# Q matrix
qtot_meas <- matrix(leze_complete$q_L.s, nrow = nrep, ncol = nobs, byrow = T) # repeats nrow_boot times the vector q_L.s
qtot_noise <- matrix(rnorm(nrep*nobs, mean = 0, sd = q_u), nrow = nrep, ncol = nobs) # creates a noise in percent (proportion), between 0 and 10%
qtot_mat <- qtot_meas * (1 + qtot_noise) # final value of q, with noise


index_years_tot <- lapply(complete_years, function(y){which(leze_complete$year == y)}) # list of indices corresponding to each year
sum_qtot <- sapply(index_years_tot, function(idx){apply(qtot_mat[,idx], 1, sum, na.rm = T)})



```

```{r compute-doc-flux}
annual_flux_ton.y <- sum_qtot*sum_loadobs/sum_qobs

# add 25% uncertainty due to method
flux_noise <- matrix(rnorm(nrep*length(complete_years), mean = 0, sd = 0.25), nrow = nrep, ncol = length(complete_years))

annual_flux_ton.y <- annual_flux_ton.y * (1 + flux_noise)

annual_flux_pi <- apply(annual_flux_ton.y, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = T) # prediction interval for annual fluxes, per year. 3 lignes, 19 columns
annual_flux_mean <- colMeans(annual_flux_ton.y, na.rm = T) # mean annual flux per year. 1 vector
annual_flux_sd <- apply(annual_flux_ton.y, 2, sd, na.rm = T) # standard deviation of annual flux per year. Is just an estimate of goodness of mean, not as good as than the confidence interval. 

annual_flux_df <- data.frame(year = complete_years, 
                        annual_flux_mean = annual_flux_mean, 
                        annual_flux_variability = annual_flux_sd, 
                        annual_flux_pi_lower = annual_flux_pi[1,], 
                        annual_flux_pi_upper = annual_flux_pi[3,])

# Interannual flux 
interannual_flux_ton.y <- rowMeans(annual_flux_ton.y, na.rm = T) # mean interannual flux per iteration of the bootstrap
interannual_flux_pi <- quantile(interannual_flux_ton.y, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = T) # prediction interval
interannual_flux_mean <- mean(interannual_flux_ton.y, na.rm = T) # mean interannual flux
interannual_flux_variability <- sd(annual_flux_mean, na.rm = T) # standard deviation of interannual flux per year

interannual_flux_df <- data.frame(year = "interannual", annual_flux_mean = interannual_flux_mean, 
                                  annual_flux_variability = interannual_flux_variability,
                        annual_flux_pi_lower = interannual_flux_pi[1], 
                        annual_flux_pi_upper = interannual_flux_pi[3])

total_flux_df <- rbind(annual_flux_df, interannual_flux_df)
total_flux_df$group <- c(rep("annual", nyears), "interannual")

# Q df ----

annual_q <- sapply(index_years_tot, function(idx){apply(qtot_mat[,idx], 1, sum, na.rm = T)}) # sum of fluxes per year, for each iteration of the bootstrap. Result is a matrix with nrow_boot rows and 19 columns (1 per year)
annual_q_pi <- apply(annual_q, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = T) # prediction interval for annual fluxes, per year. 3 lignes, 19 columns
annual_q_mean <- colMeans(annual_q, na.rm = T) # mean annual flux per year. 1 vector
annual_q_sd <- apply(annual_q, 2, sd, na.rm = T) # standard deviation of annual flux per year. Is just an estimate of goodness of mean, not as good as than the confidence interval. 
interannual_q <- rowMeans(annual_q, na.rm = T) # mean interannual flux per iteration of the bootstrap
interannual_q_pi <- quantile(interannual_q, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = T) # prediction interval
interannual_q_mean <- mean(interannual_q, na.rm = T) # mean interannual flux
interannual_q_variability <- sd(annual_q_mean, na.rm = T) # standard deviation of interannual flux per year

q_df <- data.frame(year = c(complete_years, "interannual"), 
                        q_mean = c(annual_q_mean, interannual_q_mean),
                        q_variability = c(annual_flux_sd, interannual_q_variability), 
                        q_pi_lower = c(annual_q_pi[1,], interannual_q_pi[1]), 
                        q_pi_upper = c(annual_q_pi[3,], interannual_q_pi[3]),
                   group = c(rep("annual", nyears), "interannual"))

# Plot -----
ggplot()+
  geom_col(data = total_flux_df, aes(x=year, y = annual_flux_mean, fill = group))+
    geom_errorbar(data = total_flux_df, aes(x = year, ymin = annual_flux_pi_lower, ymax = annual_flux_pi_upper, col = "prediction interval"), width = 0.3, size = 0.8)+
  geom_errorbar(data = filter(total_flux_df, year == "interannual"), aes(x = year, ymin = annual_flux_mean - annual_flux_variability, ymax = annual_flux_mean + annual_flux_variability, col = "interannual variability"), width = 0.2, size = 0.8, linetype = 2)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("annual" = "lightblue", "interannual" = "indianred"))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("prediction interval" = "darkblue", "interannual variability" = "darkred"), name = "")+
   labs(x = "Year", y = "Flux (ton/year)", fill = "")+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")

ggplot()+
  geom_col(data = q_df, aes(x=year, y = q_mean, fill = group))+
    geom_errorbar(data = q_df, aes(x = year, ymin = q_pi_lower, ymax = q_pi_upper, col = "prediction interval"), width = 0.3, size = 0.8)+
  geom_errorbar(data = filter(q_df, year == "interannual"), aes(x = year, ymin = q_mean - q_variability, ymax = q_mean + q_variability, col = "interannual variability"), width = 0.2, size = 0.8, linetype = 2)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("annual" = "lightblue", "interannual" = "indianred"))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("prediction interval" = "darkblue", "interannual variability" = "darkred"), name = "")+
   labs(x = "Year", y = "Discharge (L/year)", fill = "")+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")

knitr::kable(total_flux_df, digits = 2, row.names = F) %>% kableExtra::kable_styling()

```

### Variance decomposition

Aïe aïe le flux est calculé autrement que pour les simples sommes ! 

LOAD = sumQ * sum(load obs) / sum(q obs)

log(load) = log(sumQ) + log(sum load obs) - log(sum q obs)

log(load) = log(q1)+...+log(qtot)

```{r variance-doc}
## Variances par année

list_var <- lapply(1:length(complete_years), function(idx){
  
lnQtot <- as.vector(log(sum_qtot[,idx]))
lnloadobs <- as.vector(log(sum_loadobs[,idx]))
lnQobs <- as.vector(log(sum_qobs[,idx]))

mask <- complete.cases(lnQtot, lnloadobs, lnQobs)  &
        is.finite(lnQtot) & is.finite(lnloadobs) & is.finite(lnQobs)

M <- cbind(Qtot = lnQtot[mask], load = lnloadobs[mask], Qobs = lnQobs[mask])

cov_matrix <- cov(M, use = "pairwise.complete.obs") 

# verif
var_lnF_check <- sum(cov_matrix)
var_lnF_direct <- var(rowSums(M))

if(var_lnF_check != var_lnF_direct){warning("Attention : les variances ne correspondent pas")}

return(cov_matrix)
})

var_flux_by_year <- lapply(list_var, function(i){
  var_flux = sum(i)
  setNames(var_flux, "var_lnF")}) %>% bind_rows(.id = "year")
vars_by_year <- lapply(list_var, diag) %>% bind_rows(.id = "year") # variance des paramètres par année
cov_by_year <- lapply(list_var, function(i){
  vals <- i[upper.tri(i)]
  setNames(as.list(vals), c("cov_loadQtot","cov_QobsQtot","cov_Qobsload"))}) %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "year") 

annual_variances <- merge(var_flux_by_year, vars_by_year, by = "year") %>% merge(cov_by_year, by = "year")
annual_variances$year <- complete_years


# Variance interannuelle

lnQtot <- as.vector(log(sum_qtot))
lnloadobs <- as.vector(log(sum_loadobs))
lnQobs <- as.vector(log(sum_qobs))

mask <- complete.cases(lnQtot, lnloadobs, lnQobs)  &
        is.finite(lnQtot) & is.finite(lnloadobs) & is.finite(lnQobs)

M <- cbind(Qtot = lnQtot[mask], load = lnloadobs[mask], Qobs = lnQobs[mask])

cov_matrix <- cov(M, use = "pairwise.complete.obs") 

# verif
var_lnF_check <- sum(cov_matrix)
var_lnF <- var(rowSums(M))

if(var_lnF_check != var_lnF){warning("Attention : les variances ne correspondent pas")}


# put results in df
vars_interannual <- c(var_lnF, diag(cov_matrix)) # variance des paramètres par année
cov_interannual <- cov_matrix[upper.tri(cov_matrix)] %>%
  setNames(c("cov_loadQtot","cov_QobsQtot","cov_Qobsload")) 

interannual_variances <- c(year = "Interrannuel", vars_interannual, cov_interannual)

all_variances <- rbind(annual_variances, interannual_variances) %>% mutate(across(where(is.character) & !any_of("year"), as.numeric))



variance_decomposition <- all_variances  %>% 
  mutate(part_Qtot = Qtot/var_lnF, part_load = load/var_lnF, part_Qobs = Qobs/var_lnF, 
         part_covloadQtot = 2*cov_loadQtot/var_lnF, 
         part_covQobsQtot = 2*cov_QobsQtot/var_lnF, 
         part_covQobsload = 2*cov_Qobsload/var_lnF, 
         part_cov = part_covloadQtot + part_covQobsQtot + part_covQobsload,
         check = part_Qtot+part_load+part_Qobs+part_covloadQtot+part_covQobsQtot+part_covQobsload)


vd_long <- variance_decomposition %>%
  select(year, part_Qtot, part_load, part_Qobs, part_cov) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(part_Qtot, part_load, part_Qobs, part_cov),
               names_to = "terme", values_to = "part")  %>%
  mutate(terme = recode(terme,
                         part_Qtot = "Variance Q annuel",
                         part_load = "Variance flux instantané",
                         part_Qobs = "Variance Q flux",
                        part_cov = "Covariances"))

ggplot(vd_long, aes(x = year, y = part, fill = terme)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Variance Q annuel" = "lightblue",
                                "Variance flux instantané" = "indianred",
                                "Variance Q flux" = "darkblue",
                               "Covariances" = "darkred")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, breaks = c(-0.40,-0.20,0,0.20,0.40,0.60,0.80,1.00,1.2,1.4)) +
  labs(x = "Année", y = "Part de la variance du log-flux",
       fill = "Terme",
       title = "Décomposition de la variance du flux") +
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5))

vd_long_abs <- variance_decomposition %>%
  select(year, Qtot, load, Qobs, cov_loadQtot,cov_QobsQtot,cov_Qobsload) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -year, names_to = "terme", values_to = "valeur")

ggplot(vd_long_abs, aes(x = year, y = valeur, fill = terme)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_point(data = variance_decomposition, aes(x = year, y = var_lnF),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 18, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkblue","lightblue","darkred","indianred","palegreen4","cornsilk3"))+
   theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5))+
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log", breaks = )+
```

## MES-POC relationship

```{r mes-poc, eval = F}
leze_poc <- leze %>% subset(!is.na(poc_percent))

ggplot(leze_poc)+geom_point(aes(x = log(mes_mg.L), y = poc_percent))

aspt_value <- leze_poc[order(leze_poc$mes_mg.L, decreasing = T),] %>% pull(poc_percent) %>% head(dim(leze_poc)[1]/10) %>% mean(na.rm = T) 
aspt_value_sd <- leze_poc[order(leze_poc$mes_mg.L, decreasing = T),] %>% pull(poc_percent) %>% head(dim(leze_poc)[1]/10) %>% sd() 

leze_poc$aspt <- aspt_value

pocfit <- lm(log(poc_percent)~log(mes_mg.L), data = select(leze_poc, c(poc_percent, mes_mg.L)))

summary(pocfit)


library(nlme)

# fit gnls
pocfitg <- gnls(
  poc_percent ~ a*mes_mg.L^b + aspt,
  data = select(leze_poc, c(mes_mg.L, poc_percent, aspt)),
  start = list(a = coef(pocfit)[[2]], b = coef(pocfit)[[1]]), # on utilise les valeurs de pocfit comme coefficients initiaux
  weights = varPower(value = 1, form = ~ fitted(.)),
  control = gnlsControl(nlsTol = 1e-3, tolerance = 1e-4)
)

# summary 
summary(pocfitg) %>% print()

# variance parameters
theta <- as.numeric(coef(pocfitg$modelStruct$varStruct, unconstrained = F))
sigma_gnls <- pocfitg$sigma

# formula
formula_pocfitg <- paste("GNLS:", round(coef(pocfitg)[1], 3), "x MES ^", round(coef(pocfitg)[2],3), "+", round(aspt_value, 3), sep = "")

## model function 
f <- function(x, a, b, aspt){
  a * x ^ b + aspt
}

# prepare dataframe
leze_gnls <- leze 

na_lines <- which(is.na(leze_gnls$mes_mg.L)) # 0
zero_lines <- which(leze_gnls$mes_mg.L == 0)
fit_lines <- which(leze_gnls$mes_mg.L != 0 & !is.na(leze_gnls$mes_mg.L))

leze_nas_gnls <- leze_gnls[fit_lines, ]
leze_nas_gnls$aspt <- aspt_value # from nls fitting

# predict POC pour mes > 0
poc_fitted <- predict(pocfitg, newdata = leze_nas_gnls, na.action = na.pass)
leze_gnls$poc_fitted <- NA_real_
leze_gnls[fit_lines, ]$poc_fitted <- as.numeric(poc_fitted)
leze_gnls[zero_lines, ]$poc_fitted <- 0
leze_gnls[na_lines, ]$poc_fitted <- NA

ggplot(leze_gnls)+geom_point(aes(x=mes_mg.L, y = poc_fitted))+
  geom_point(aes(x=mes_mg.L, y = poc_percent, col = "measured"))+
  labs(y = "POC %, fitted", x = "MES, g/L")+theme_bw()
```

```{r intervalles-de-confiance-coefficients-bootstrap, eval = F}
n_boot <- 1000
n_obs <- dim(leze_poc)[1]

coefs_boot <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_boot, ncol = 2, dimnames = list(NULL, c("a","b")))
                     

for(i in seq_len(n_boot)){
  
  idx_boot <- sample(n_obs, replace = T)
  df_boot <- leze_poc[idx_boot, c("mes_mg.L","poc_percent","aspt")]
  
  tryCatch(
    {fit_init <- nls(
      poc_percent ~ a * mes_mg.L^b + aspt,
      data = df_boot,
      start = coef(pocfitg))
      # fit init is necessary to find the correct starting values for gnls. Otherwise, too much convergence result in extreme values in a and b

      pocfit_bg <- gnls(
      poc_percent~a*mes_mg.L^b+aspt,
      data = df_boot,
      start = coef(fit_init),
      weights = varPower(form = ~fitted(.)),
      control = gnlsControl(nlsTol = 1e-3, tolerance = 1e-4, maxIter = 200))
      
      coefs_boot[i,] <- coef(pocfit_bg)
      }, 
    error = function(e) NULL) 
}

# removes NA
coefs_boot <- na.omit(coefs_boot)
apply(coefs_boot, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)) %>% knitr::kable() #ic coef
ggplot(as.data.frame(coefs_boot))+
  geom_point(aes(x = a, y = b))+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)+
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# adds uncertainty around aspt
coefs_boot <- cbind(coefs_boot, "aspt" = aspt_value)

# compute POC
fitted_boot <- apply(coefs_boot, 1, function(p){p["a"] * leze_poc$mes_mg.L^p["b"] + p["aspt"]}) # MC worlds in columns
fitted_boot_ic <- apply(fitted_boot, 1, quantile, 
                 probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE) # prediction intervals
fitted_boot_mean <- apply(fitted_boot, 1, mean) # meet bottstrapped valur

# intergrates in leze
poc_leze_boot_gnls <- leze_poc %>% mutate(poc_fitted = fitted_boot_mean, upr = fitted_boot_ic[3, ], lwr = fitted_boot_ic[1,])

ggplot(poc_leze_boot_gnls)+
  geom_point(aes(x=mes_mg.L, y = poc_percent, col = "measured", shape = "measured"))+ 
  geom_point(aes(x=mes_mg.L, y = poc_fitted, col = "fitted", shape = "fitted"))+ 
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = mes_mg.L, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_abline(slope = 0, intercept = aspt_value, col = "darkred")+
  annotate(geom = "label", label = formula_pocfitg, x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkblue", "lightblue"))+
  labs(x = "MES, mg/L", y = "POC, %", colour = "", shape = "", title = "POC% measured and fitted vs MES measured",subtitle = "Confidence interval in grey")+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)

ggplot(poc_leze_boot_gnls, aes(x=poc_percent))+
  geom_point(aes(y=poc_fitted), col = "darkblue")+ 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, col = "darkred")+
  annotate(geom = "label", label = formula_pocfitg, x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1)+
  labs(x = "POC measured", y = "POC fitted", colour = "", shape = "", title = "POC fitted vs measured",subtitle = "Confidence interval in grey")+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)
```

```{r pred-poc-gnls, eval = F}
nrow_boot <- nrow(coefs_boot)
nrow_leze <- nrow(leze)
mes_u <- 0.5


# MES matrix
mes_meas <- matrix(leze$mes_mg.L, nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_leze, byrow = T) # repeats nrow_boot times the vector leze$mes_mg.L
mes_noise <- matrix(rnorm(nrow_boot*nrow_leze, mean = 0, sd = mes_u), nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_leze) # 
mes_mat <- mes_meas * (1 + mes_noise) # final value of q, with noise. 


# Prediction matrix, no model noise
mu_gnls <- f(mes_mat, coefs_boot[,"a"], coefs_boot[,"b"], coefs_boot[,"aspt"])

# Prediction matrix, with noise
noise_mat_gnls <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_leze)
sigma_mat_gnls <- sigma_gnls * abs(mu_gnls)^theta # variance depends on predicted value

noise_mat_gnls <- matrix(rnorm(nrow_boot*nrow_leze, mean = 0, sd = 1), nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_leze)
noise_mat_gnls <- noise_mat_gnls*sigma_mat_gnls

pred_gnls <- mu_gnls + noise_mat_gnls

mes_mat_zeros <- which(mes_mat == 0)
pred_gnls[mes_mat_zeros] <- 0
pred_gnls <- pmin(pmax(pred_gnls, 0), 100) # clampe pred_nls pour éviter les intervalles de prédiction en dessous de zéro et au dessus de 100 (no case)

# Prediction interval 
pi <- t(apply(pred_gnls, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = T))
colnames(pi) <- c("lower", "upper")

# Mean bootstrap value
boot_pred_gnls <- colMeans(pred_gnls, na.rm = T)

## insert in leze
leze <- leze %>% mutate(poc_boot_pred = boot_pred_gnls,
                          poc_pred_lower = pi[,1],
                          poc_pred_upper = pi[,2])

# variances
leze$poc_var_mean <- apply(mu_gnls, 2, var, na.rm = T) # variance of fit parameters + MES 
leze$poc_var_tot <- apply(pred_gnls, 2, var, na.rm = T) # total variance per prediction, for prediction total uncertainty

# plot
ggplot(leze, aes(x = mes_mg.L))+
  geom_line(aes(y = poc_pred_lower, ymax = poc_pred_upper), col = "gray50")+
  geom_line(aes(y = poc_pred_upper), col = "gray50")+
  geom_point(aes(y = poc_percent, col = "measured"), alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5)+
  geom_point(aes(y = 118.6*mes_mg.L^(-1.29)+aspt_value, col = "fitted with all events"), size = 2)+
  geom_point(aes(y = poc_boot_pred, col ="poc_boot_pred"), alpha = 0.5, size = 1)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkblue","gray50","lightblue"))+
  geom_abline(slope = 0, intercept = aspt_value, col = "darkred")+
  annotate(geom = "label", label = formula_pocfitg, x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1)+
  labs(x = "MES, mg/L", y = "POC, %", colour = "", shape = "", title = "POC predicted from MES",subtitle = "Prediction interval in grey")+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# plot
ggplot(leze, aes(x = mes_mg.L))+
  geom_line(aes(y = poc_pred_lower, ymax = poc_pred_upper), col = "gray50")+
  geom_line(aes(y = poc_pred_upper), col = "gray50")+
  geom_point(aes(y = poc_percent, col = "measured"), alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5)+
  geom_point(aes(y = 118.6*mes_mg.L^(-1.29)+aspt_value, col = "fitted with all events"), size = 2)+
  geom_point(aes(y = poc_boot_pred, col ="poc_boot_pred"), alpha = 0.5, size = 1)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkblue","gray50","lightblue"))+
  geom_abline(slope = 0, intercept = aspt_value, col = "darkred")+
  annotate(geom = "label", label = formula_pocfitg, x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1)+
  labs(x = "MES, mg/L", y = "POC, %", colour = "", shape = "", title = "POC predicted from MES",subtitle = "Prediction interval in grey")+
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log")+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

```


bootstrapping has very different results then direct fitting


## Annual and interannual POC flux

### total flux

```{r poc-flux-for-obs}
leze_poc <- leze_complete %>% filter(!is.na(poc_mg.L)) %>% mutate(poc_percent_fitted = 118.6*mes_mg.L^(-1.29)+0.18, poc_fitted = mes_mg.L*poc_percent_fitted)

  
nrep <- 1000
nobs <- dim(leze_poc)[1]

poc_meas <- matrix(leze_poc$poc_fitted, nrow = nrep, ncol = nobs, byrow = T)
poc_cv <- 3.3*poc_meas^(-0.6) # from all data available on 29/05/2026
poc_random <- matrix(rnorm(nrep*nobs, mean = 0, sd = 1), nrow=nrep, ncol = nobs)
poc_noise <- poc_cv*poc_random
poc_mat <- poc_meas * (1 + poc_noise/100) # final value of poc, with noise in percent

# Q matrix
q_meas <- matrix(leze_poc$q_L.s, nrow = nrep, ncol = nobs, byrow = T) # repeats nrow_boot times the vector q_L.s
q_noise <- matrix(rnorm(nrep*nobs, mean = 0, sd = q_u), nrow = nrep, ncol = nobs) # creates a noise in percent (proportion), between 0 and 10%
q_mat <- q_meas * (1 + q_noise) # final value of q, with noise

# period 
period_mat <- matrix(leze_poc$period, nrow = nrep, ncol = nobs, byrow = T) # in seconds

# Flux per time step
load_ton.s_mat <- poc_mat*1e-9*q_mat*600 # period fixed to 600 s -> otherwise outliers

# Annual flux
index_years <- lapply(complete_years, function(y){which(leze_poc$year == y)}) # list of indices corresponding to each year
sum_loadobs <- sapply(index_years, function(idx){apply(load_ton.s_mat[,idx], 1, sum, na.rm = T)}) # 1 col per year

sum_qobs <- sapply(index_years, function(idx){apply(q_mat[,idx], 1, sum, na.rm = T)})

```

```{r sum-q-tot-poc, cache.lazy = F}

nrep <- 1000
nobs <- dim(leze_complete)[1]

# Q matrix
qtot_meas <- matrix(leze_complete$q_L.s, nrow = nrep, ncol = nobs, byrow = T) # repeats nrow_boot times the vector q_L.s
qtot_noise <- matrix(rnorm(nrep*nobs, mean = 0, sd = q_u), nrow = nrep, ncol = nobs) # creates a noise in percent (proportion), between 0 and 10%
qtot_mat <- qtot_meas * (1 + qtot_noise) # final value of q, with noise


index_years_tot <- lapply(complete_years, function(y){which(leze_complete$year == y)}) # list of indices corresponding to each year
sum_qtot <- sapply(index_years_tot, function(idx){apply(qtot_mat[,idx], 1, sum, na.rm = T)})



```

```{r compute-poc-flux}
annual_flux_ton.y <- sum_qtot*sum_loadobs/sum_qobs

# add 25% uncertainty due to method
flux_noise <- matrix(rnorm(nrep*length(complete_years), mean = 0, sd = 0.25), nrow = nrep, ncol = length(complete_years))

annual_flux_ton.y <- annual_flux_ton.y * (1 + flux_noise)

annual_flux_pi <- apply(annual_flux_ton.y, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = T) # prediction interval for annual fluxes, per year. 3 lignes, 19 columns
annual_flux_mean <- colMeans(annual_flux_ton.y, na.rm = T) # mean annual flux per year. 1 vector
annual_flux_sd <- apply(annual_flux_ton.y, 2, sd, na.rm = T) # standard deviation of annual flux per year. Is just an estimate of goodness of mean, not as good as than the confidence interval. 

annual_flux_df <- data.frame(year = complete_years, 
                        annual_flux_mean = annual_flux_mean, 
                        annual_flux_variability = annual_flux_sd, 
                        annual_flux_pi_lower = annual_flux_pi[1,], 
                        annual_flux_pi_upper = annual_flux_pi[3,])

# Interannual flux 
interannual_flux_ton.y <- rowMeans(annual_flux_ton.y, na.rm = T) # mean interannual flux per iteration of the bootstrap
interannual_flux_pi <- quantile(interannual_flux_ton.y, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = T) # prediction interval
interannual_flux_mean <- mean(interannual_flux_ton.y, na.rm = T) # mean interannual flux
interannual_flux_variability <- sd(annual_flux_mean, na.rm = T) # standard deviation of interannual flux per year

interannual_flux_df <- data.frame(year = "interannual", annual_flux_mean = interannual_flux_mean, 
                                  annual_flux_variability = interannual_flux_variability,
                        annual_flux_pi_lower = interannual_flux_pi[1], 
                        annual_flux_pi_upper = interannual_flux_pi[3])

total_flux_df <- rbind(annual_flux_df, interannual_flux_df)
total_flux_df$group <- c(rep("annual", nyears), "interannual")

# Q df ----

annual_q <- sapply(index_years_tot, function(idx){apply(qtot_mat[,idx], 1, sum, na.rm = T)}) # sum of fluxes per year, for each iteration of the bootstrap. Result is a matrix with nrow_boot rows and 19 columns (1 per year)
annual_q_pi <- apply(annual_q, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = T) # prediction interval for annual fluxes, per year. 3 lignes, 19 columns
annual_q_mean <- colMeans(annual_q, na.rm = T) # mean annual flux per year. 1 vector
annual_q_sd <- apply(annual_q, 2, sd, na.rm = T) # standard deviation of annual flux per year. Is just an estimate of goodness of mean, not as good as than the confidence interval. 
interannual_q <- rowMeans(annual_q, na.rm = T) # mean interannual flux per iteration of the bootstrap
interannual_q_pi <- quantile(interannual_q, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = T) # prediction interval
interannual_q_mean <- mean(interannual_q, na.rm = T) # mean interannual flux
interannual_q_variability <- sd(annual_q_mean, na.rm = T) # standard deviation of interannual flux per year

q_df <- data.frame(year = c(complete_years, "interannual"), 
                        q_mean = c(annual_q_mean, interannual_q_mean),
                        q_variability = c(annual_flux_sd, interannual_q_variability), 
                        q_pi_lower = c(annual_q_pi[1,], interannual_q_pi[1]), 
                        q_pi_upper = c(annual_q_pi[3,], interannual_q_pi[3]),
                   group = c(rep("annual", nyears), "interannual"))

# Plot -----
ggplot()+
  geom_col(data = total_flux_df, aes(x=year, y = annual_flux_mean, fill = group))+
    geom_errorbar(data = total_flux_df, aes(x = year, ymin = annual_flux_pi_lower, ymax = annual_flux_pi_upper, col = "prediction interval"), width = 0.3, size = 0.8)+
  geom_errorbar(data = filter(total_flux_df, year == "interannual"), aes(x = year, ymin = annual_flux_mean - annual_flux_variability, ymax = annual_flux_mean + annual_flux_variability, col = "interannual variability"), width = 0.2, size = 0.8, linetype = 2)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("annual" = "lightblue", "interannual" = "indianred"))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("prediction interval" = "darkblue", "interannual variability" = "darkred"), name = "")+
   labs(x = "Year", y = "Flux (ton/year)", fill = "")+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")

ggplot()+
  geom_col(data = q_df, aes(x=year, y = q_mean, fill = group))+
    geom_errorbar(data = q_df, aes(x = year, ymin = q_pi_lower, ymax = q_pi_upper, col = "prediction interval"), width = 0.3, size = 0.8)+
  geom_errorbar(data = filter(q_df, year == "interannual"), aes(x = year, ymin = q_mean - q_variability, ymax = q_mean + q_variability, col = "interannual variability"), width = 0.2, size = 0.8, linetype = 2)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("annual" = "lightblue", "interannual" = "indianred"))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("prediction interval" = "darkblue", "interannual variability" = "darkred"), name = "")+
   labs(x = "Year", y = "Discharge (L/year)", fill = "")+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")

knitr::kable(total_flux_df, digits = 2, row.names = F) %>% kableExtra::kable_styling()
```

### Variance decomposition

Aïe aïe le flux est calculé autrement que pour les simples sommes ! 

LOAD = sumQ * sum(load obs) / sum(q obs)

log(load) = log(sumQ) + log(sum load obs) - log(sum q obs)

log(load) = log(q1)+...+log(qtot)

```{r variance-poc}
## Variances par année

list_var <- lapply(1:length(complete_years), function(idx){
  
lnQtot <- as.vector(log(sum_qtot[,idx]))
lnloadobs <- as.vector(log(sum_loadobs[,idx]))
lnQobs <- as.vector(log(sum_qobs[,idx]))

mask <- complete.cases(lnQtot, lnloadobs, lnQobs)  &
        is.finite(lnQtot) & is.finite(lnloadobs) & is.finite(lnQobs)

M <- cbind(Qtot = lnQtot[mask], load = lnloadobs[mask], Qobs = lnQobs[mask])

cov_matrix <- cov(M, use = "pairwise.complete.obs") 

# verif
var_lnF_check <- sum(cov_matrix)
var_lnF_direct <- var(rowSums(M))

if(var_lnF_check != var_lnF_direct){warning("Attention : les variances ne correspondent pas")}

return(cov_matrix)
})

var_flux_by_year <- lapply(list_var, function(i){
  var_flux = sum(i)
  setNames(var_flux, "var_lnF")}) %>% bind_rows(.id = "year")
vars_by_year <- lapply(list_var, diag) %>% bind_rows(.id = "year") # variance des paramètres par année
cov_by_year <- lapply(list_var, function(i){
  vals <- i[upper.tri(i)]
  setNames(as.list(vals), c("cov_loadQtot","cov_QobsQtot","cov_Qobsload"))}) %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "year") 

annual_variances <- merge(var_flux_by_year, vars_by_year, by = "year") %>% merge(cov_by_year, by = "year")
annual_variances$year <- complete_years


# Variance interannuelle

lnQtot <- as.vector(log(sum_qtot))
lnloadobs <- as.vector(log(sum_loadobs))
lnQobs <- as.vector(log(sum_qobs))

mask <- complete.cases(lnQtot, lnloadobs, lnQobs)  &
        is.finite(lnQtot) & is.finite(lnloadobs) & is.finite(lnQobs)

M <- cbind(Qtot = lnQtot[mask], load = lnloadobs[mask], Qobs = lnQobs[mask])

cov_matrix <- cov(M, use = "pairwise.complete.obs") 

# verif
var_lnF_check <- sum(cov_matrix)
var_lnF <- var(rowSums(M))

if(var_lnF_check != var_lnF){warning("Attention : les variances ne correspondent pas")}


# put results in df
vars_interannual <- c(var_lnF, diag(cov_matrix)) # variance des paramètres par année
cov_interannual <- cov_matrix[upper.tri(cov_matrix)] %>%
  setNames(c("cov_loadQtot","cov_QobsQtot","cov_Qobsload")) 

interannual_variances <- c(year = "Interrannuel", vars_interannual, cov_interannual)

all_variances <- rbind(annual_variances, interannual_variances) %>% mutate(across(where(is.character) & !any_of("year"), as.numeric))



variance_decomposition <- all_variances  %>% 
  mutate(part_Qtot = Qtot/var_lnF, part_load = load/var_lnF, part_Qobs = Qobs/var_lnF, 
         part_covloadQtot = 2*cov_loadQtot/var_lnF, 
         part_covQobsQtot = 2*cov_QobsQtot/var_lnF, 
         part_covQobsload = 2*cov_Qobsload/var_lnF, 
         part_cov = part_covloadQtot + part_covQobsQtot + part_covQobsload,
         check = part_Qtot+part_load+part_Qobs+part_covloadQtot+part_covQobsQtot+part_covQobsload)


vd_long <- variance_decomposition %>%
  select(year, part_Qtot, part_load, part_Qobs, part_cov) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(part_Qtot, part_load, part_Qobs, part_cov),
               names_to = "terme", values_to = "part")  %>%
  mutate(terme = recode(terme,
                         part_Qtot = "Variance Q annuel",
                         part_load = "Variance flux instantané",
                         part_Qobs = "Variance Q flux",
                        part_cov = "Covariances"))

ggplot(vd_long, aes(x = year, y = part, fill = terme)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Variance Q annuel" = "lightblue",
                                "Variance flux instantané" = "indianred",
                                "Variance Q flux" = "darkblue",
                               "Covariances" = "darkred")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, breaks = c(-0.40,-0.20,0,0.20,0.40,0.60,0.80,1.00,1.2,1.4)) +
  labs(x = "Année", y = "Part de la variance du log-flux",
       fill = "Terme",
       title = "Décomposition de la variance du flux") +
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5))

vd_long_abs <- variance_decomposition %>%
  select(year, Qtot, load, Qobs, cov_loadQtot,cov_QobsQtot,cov_Qobsload) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -year, names_to = "terme", values_to = "valeur")

ggplot(vd_long_abs, aes(x = year, y = valeur, fill = terme)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_point(data = variance_decomposition, aes(x = year, y = var_lnF),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 18, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkblue","lightblue","darkred","indianred","palegreen4","cornsilk3"))+
   theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5))+
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log", breaks = )+
  labs(y = "Variance (échelle log)", title = "Termes de la décomposition (valeurs absolues)")

```
